title: IMet-1 RS Radiosonde
short: Radiosonde launched on a weather balloon.
desc:
This Radiosonde is mostly used in Israel, Belgium, USA as well as South Africa. The IMET range of radiosondes is manufactured by Intermet [https://www.intermet.co] www.intermet.co
The iMet 54 is the latest product in the Intermet range. The iMet 4 is a more modern radiosonde, and more compact while the iMet 1 is an older model which is almost not used in 2021.
It also has a bit wider bandwidth.
